in_scope_areas: Cross-field dependency between Division and Locations

test_cases.title: Department Management page loads with expected controls and listing
preconditions: User is authenticated with access to Department Management.
steps: Observe the page header, search field, Search button, Division filter, Status filter, Columns selector, listing table, Add New button, rows-per-page control, and pagination controls.
expected_results: Department Management page loads successfully without errors.
Core controls are visible and enabled based on user permissions.
Department listing table renders with department records or a valid empty-state message.

test_cases.title: Search returns matching department records for a valid department name
preconditions: At least one known department exists.
steps: Enter a valid existing department name in the Department search field.
expected_results: Search results are shown.
Returned records match the entered department name or expected partial-match behavior.
No unrelated department rows are shown.

test_cases.title: Search shows no-results state for an unmatched department name
preconditions: User is on /admin/departments.
steps: Enter a department name that does not exist.
expected_results: A visible no-results state is displayed.
The page indicates that no departments were found.
The page remains usable for another search attempt.

validations: An unmatched search returns a visible 'No departments found' state.

test_cases.title: Search handles leading and trailing spaces in department input
preconditions: At least one known department exists.
steps: Enter a valid department name with leading and trailing spaces.
expected_results: Search behavior is consistent with trimmed user input.
The matching department is returned rather than treated as a distinct string.

test_cases.title: Division filter narrows the listing to the selected division
preconditions: Department data exists across more than one division.
steps: Select a division from the Division filter.
expected_results: Listing refreshes to show only departments associated with the selected division.
Records outside the selected division are excluded.

test_cases.title: Status filter narrows the listing to the selected status
preconditions: Department data exists in the selected status.
steps: Select Active or Inactive from the Status filter.
expected_results: Listing refreshes to show only departments matching the selected status.
Rows with a different status are excluded.

test_cases.title: Division and Status filters work correctly in combination
preconditions: Department data exists for multiple divisions and statuses.
expected_results: Displayed rows satisfy both filters at the same time.
Changing one filter recalculates the result set without stale rows.

test_cases.title: Department column sort toggles record order
preconditions: At least three departments exist with distinct names.
steps: Click the Department column header once.
Click the Department column header again.
expected_results: The Department column sort is applied.
The displayed order changes between ascending and descending states or equivalent supported sort states.
Displayed data stays consistent with the active result set.

test_cases.title: Created On column sort toggles chronological order
preconditions: Multiple departments exist with different creation timestamps.
steps: Click the Created On column header once.
Click the Created On column header again.
expected_results: The listing is reordered by creation date.
The sort direction changes across repeated clicks or supported sort states.

test_cases.title: Columns selector can hide and show department listing columns
preconditions: Columns selector is available on the page.
expected_results: Selected column visibility changes are reflected in the table.
Re-enabled columns become visible again without breaking table layout.

test_cases.title: Rows per page control updates page size
preconditions: There are more records than the default page size.
steps: Change the page size from the default value to 10.
expected_results: The listing refreshes using the selected page size.
The number of visible rows per page matches the selected value or the remaining record count on the last page.
Pagination count recalculates correctly.

test_cases.title: Next and Previous pagination navigate correctly between pages
preconditions: There are enough records to create at least two pages.
steps: Go to page 1 of the department listing.
expected_results: Next navigates to the next page of records.
Previous returns to the prior page.
Page content changes consistently with pagination state.

test_cases.title: Pagination boundary states disable Previous on first page and Next on last page
preconditions: There are enough records to create more than one page.
steps: Open the first page of the listing.
expected_results: Previous is disabled or unavailable on the first page.
Next is disabled or unavailable on the last page.

validations: Pagination boundaries are enforced with Previous disabled on the first page and Next disabled on the last page.

test_cases.title: Search, filter, and sort remain internally consistent when used together
preconditions: Test data supports search, division filtering, and sorting.
steps: Search for a valid department keyword.
Sort by Department or Created On.
expected_results: Rows satisfy the active search and filter conditions.
Sorting is applied only within the active result set.
No stale rows from previous states remain visible.

test_cases.title: Add Department modal opens with all expected input controls
preconditions: User has permission to create departments.
expected_results: Add Department modal opens successfully.
Department Name, Description, Division, Locations, Status, and Cancel controls are visible.
Form is ready for data entry.

test_cases.title: Cancel in Add Department closes the modal without saving
preconditions: Add Department modal is open.
steps: Enter data into one or more fields.
expected_results: Add Department modal closes.
No new department is created.
Department listing remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Submitting Add Department with all required fields empty shows validation errors
preconditions: Add Department modal is open in an environment where form submission is allowed.
expected_results: Submission is blocked.
Required validation is shown for Department Name, Division, and Locations.
No department record is created.

validations: Department Name is marked required in the add flow.
Division is marked required in the add flow.
Locations is marked required in the add flow.

test_cases.title: Department Name is mandatory in Add Department
preconditions: Add Department modal is open.
steps: Populate Division and Locations with valid values.
expected_results: Submission is blocked.
Validation indicates Department Name is required.
Entered values in other fields remain available for correction.

validations: Department Name is marked required in the add flow.

test_cases.title: Division is mandatory in Add Department
preconditions: Add Department modal is open.
steps: Select one or more Locations only if the UI allows it before Division selection.
expected_results: Submission is blocked.
Validation indicates Division is required.

validations: Division is marked required in the add flow.

test_cases.title: Locations are mandatory in Add Department
preconditions: Add Department modal is open.
expected_results: Submission is blocked.
Validation indicates Locations are required.

validations: Locations is marked required in the add flow.

test_cases.title: Add Department defaults status to Active
preconditions: Add Department modal is opened fresh.
steps: Observe the Status field before making any status change.
expected_results: Status defaults to Active.

validations: Status defaults to Active and supports switching to Inactive.

test_cases.title: Add Department allows changing status from Active to Inactive
preconditions: Add Department modal is open.
steps: Change the value from Active to Inactive.
expected_results: Status selection updates to Inactive.
The form remains valid for submission after the change.

validations: Status defaults to Active and supports switching to Inactive.

test_cases.title: Locations list is constrained by the selected Division in Add Department
preconditions: Multiple divisions exist with different location sets.
steps: Select Division A and review the available Locations.
Change to Division B and review the available Locations again.
expected_results: Location options are populated based on the selected division.
Location options change when the division changes.
Locations outside the selected division are not offered.

capabilities: Resolve location options based on the selected division in the department form.
validations: Location choices are dependent on the selected division before save, indicating a cross-field dependency.

test_cases.title: Creating a department with valid mandatory data succeeds
preconditions: User has create permission.
Safe test data values are available.
Form submission is permitted in the target environment.
steps: Select one or more valid Locations.
Keep or choose a valid Status.
expected_results: Department is created successfully.
Modal closes or success feedback is shown.
New department appears in the listing and is searchable.

capabilities: Open the Add Department modal and populate department name, description, division, location, and status without submitting.
coverage_gap_origin: Add Department submit was intentionally not executed.

test_cases.title: Newly created inactive department appears correctly under Inactive filter
preconditions: User can create departments.
Form submission is permitted in the target environment.
steps: Create a new department with Status set to Inactive.
Search for the newly created department if needed.
expected_results: The new department is visible under the Inactive filter.
The new department does not appear under an Active-only view.

test_cases.title: Edit Department modal opens with existing values prefilled
preconditions: At least one editable department record exists.
User has edit permission.
steps: Click Edit department for an existing row.
expected_results: Edit Department modal opens successfully.
Existing Department Name and Description are prefilled.
Current Division, Locations, and Status are shown for the selected record.

capabilities: Open the Edit Department modal and inspect prefilled department values.

test_cases.title: Cancel in Edit Department closes the modal without updating the record
preconditions: Edit Department modal is open for an existing record.
steps: Change one or more editable values.
expected_results: Edit Department modal closes.
No changes are saved to the department record.
Listing values remain unchanged after reopening the record.

test_cases.title: Editing an existing department updates core fields successfully
preconditions: User has edit permission.
At least one editable department exists.
Form submission is permitted in the target environment.
steps: Open Edit Department for an existing record.
expected_results: Update succeeds.
Reopened record shows the new values.
Updated values appear in the listing and search results.

coverage_gap_origin: Update Department submit was intentionally not executed.

test_cases.title: Changing Division during edit refreshes available Locations accordingly
preconditions: Editable department exists.
At least two divisions exist with different location sets.
steps: Change the Division to a different value.
expected_results: Location choices refresh according to the newly selected division.
Any no-longer-valid prior location selection is cleared or flagged for correction according to product behavior.

cross_module_dependencies: Location options depend on the selected division, indicating a dependency on location master data.

test_cases.title: Department Management access is restricted for users without the required admin permission
preconditions: A non-authorized user account is available.
steps: Sign in with a user who lacks Departments admin access.
expected_results: Access is denied, redirected, or the page/action controls are hidden based on the security design.
Unauthorized users cannot create or edit departments.

cross_module_dependencies: Access to Department Management and edit actions depends on authenticated admin/security context.
